text: The purpose of this report is to request City Council authority to enter into two (2) separate non-competitive contracts with Directrik Inc., and HD Compression Inc., for the supply of proprietary parts, supplies and services. The initial term of Directrik Inc., contract will be from the date of award to December 31, 2024 and the initial term of HD Compression contract will be from August 01, 2024 to December 31, 2024. Both contracts will have the option to extend the agreement for up to six (6) separate one (1) year periods, at the sole discretion of the City and subject to budget approvals, in the total amount of $17,758,674, net of all taxes and charges ($18,071,227 net of Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries).
